item.title: Gardner police discontinue Flock cameras as license plate readers face scrutiny
item.description:
📝 Gardner police discontinue Flock cameras as license plate readers face scrutinyAdvertisementUpdated: 6:39 PM CDT Aug 18, 2026Editorial Standards ⓘNick SloanDigital Content ProducerGardner police discontinue Flock cameras as license plate readers face scrutinyUpdated: 6:39 PM CDT Aug 18, 2026Editorial Standards ⓘNick SloanDigital Content ProducerGARDNER, Kan. The Gardner Police Department confirmed it discontinued all Flock cameras and notified the provider that the contract was canceled. Gardner City Council member Kelly Johnson said the council's action only applies to cameras controlled by the city.
